steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Prevent vendor additions during event creation as required by the case.
Enable the case's price-cap read-only configuration.
Set the single-stage event type to RFQ.
Choose the first available RFQ template, equivalent to choosing Buy Template.
Add the specified product with quantity 10 so the Participants control is available.
Confirm the Participants panel is open before entering All Vendors.
Confirm the All Vendors window opened.
Cancel the All Vendors window without saving changes.
Assert that the All Vendors window closed.
Assert that the screen returned to the Participants panel.
Verify that cancelling produced no application error.
